summary: Iteration 29 (profile extras + admin hours adjust + member personnel-brief + founders mediaUrl rewrite) fully validated. Backend: 13/13 new pytest cases pass (test_iteration29_profile_hours_brief.py) and the combined regression suite (iter25+iter27+iter28+iter29 = 73 tests) passes in 30s. Verified: (a) PUT /members/me persists marital_status, languages[], civilian_degrees[] (round-trip via GET /auth/me); server does NOT cap at 3 languages / 5 degrees (UI enforces, server accepts >max), and {languages:[], civilian_degrees:[], marital_status:''} correctly clears the data; (b) PUT /hours/{id}/review with {status:'approved', hours:4.5, note:...} flips status AND adjusts hours and stamps hours_adjusted_by_name + hours_adjusted_at; repeat with {status:'approved', hours:6} re-edits hours without losing audit fields; {status:'pending'} reverts approval (new pending status is accepted); (c) GET /me/personnel-brief returns full payload (member, chapter, tier, awards, hours, events, rsvps, checkins, transactions, totals, generated_at) with identical key set to admin /reports/personnel-brief/{user_id}; (d) GET /me/personnel-brief/pdf returns Content-Type application/pdf, header %PDF, attachment, >1 KB (verified content[:4]==b'%PDF' and len > 1024); (e) Member cannot call /reports/personnel-brief/{other_user_id} (403); (f) Regression smokes still pass — /auth/login email & username, /events list, /payments/zeffy/validate (GET). Frontend: Verified via Playwright — (1) Member /profile shows the 'Download my brief' header button (data-testid=download-my-brief-btn) AND the Marital status dropdown (data-testid=profile-marital-status) next to Phone AND the LanguagesEditor (data-testid=languages-editor + add-language-btn) AND the CivilianDegreesEditor (data-testid=degrees-editor + add-degree-btn) AND the Save button (data-testid=profile-save-btn) — all present and rendered as designed. (2) Admin /hours → Review queue → Approved sub-tab shows 'Edit hrs' link (data-testid=edit-hours-{id}); clicking it reveals the inline number input (data-testid=edit-hours-input-{id}) + Save button (data-testid=save-hours-{id}) + cancel — so admins CAN re-edit hours after approval. (3) Code review of mediaUrl(): in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js, the function correctly rewrites any *.emergentagent.com origin to the current BACKEND_URL (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL); /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx wraps every image src (founders, leadership, avatars, event covers, news covers) with mediaUrl() — fix is complete and consistent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py review_hours(): cleanly stamps hours_adjusted_by/_by_name/_at ONLY when body.hours is not None, preserving the previous audit on no-op status flips. Status='pending' is now accepted (revert path).

_personnel_brief_data() is a clean shared helper used by both admin /reports/personnel-brief/{uid} and member /me/personnel-brief — eliminates duplication and guarantees identical shape (confirmed by set-equal key assertion).

Member-side /me/personnel-brief and /me/personnel-brief/pdf correctly use get_current_user (not admin_tab_dep), so any authenticated member gets their own data only — the admin endpoint /reports/personnel-brief/{other_user_id} continues to enforce admin role (403 for member), which we verified.

ProfileUpdateIn extended with marital_status (str), languages (List[LanguageEntry]), civilian_degrees (List[CivilianDegreeEntry]). Pydantic validates entry sub-fields but the parent list itself has no max-length (which is intentional — UI caps to 3/5 with a disabled add-button).

mediaUrl() rewrite logic uses URL parsing and a regex /emergentagent\.com$/i on hostname to catch ALL stale Emergent preview hosts (e.g. xyz-preview.emergentagent.com) and rewrite to current BACKEND_URL. Defensive try/catch fallback to pass-through on parse errors. This addresses the original Safari/MacBook bug.

Hours.jsx AdminHoursActions: 'Edit hrs' link is available on rows regardless of status (pending or already-approved), allowing admins to correct values post-approval. Inline edit shows numeric input + Save + cancel link — wired to PUT /hours/{id}/review with {status: existing_status, hours: newValue} which preserves status (verified end-to-end on Approved tab).

Profile.jsx Download-my-brief button: triggers a GET /me/personnel-brief/pdf — the endpoint sets Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=personnel-brief-{name}-{date}.pdf so browsers download cleanly.

ProfileExtrasEditor.jsx exposes well-named data-testids (profile-marital-status, languages-editor, add-language-btn, language-name-{i}, language-speaking-{i}, language-reading-{i}, language-writing-{i}, language-year-{i}, language-remove-{i}, degrees-editor, add-degree-btn, degree-{level,type,field,institution,month,year}-{i}) — all match the spec for deterministic testability.
Minor (LOW, carry-over from iter27/iter28): the per-row 'edit-event-{id}' data-testid on Admin Events list is still missing. Not introduced this iteration, unrelated to current deliverables.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (download-my-brief btn, marital-status, languages-editor, degrees-editor, save-btn, admin edit-hrs inline editor + save all confirmed)

seed_data_creation: Test hours row (TEST_iter29 cleanup, agency=TEST_iter29 agency) created for member; deleted in fixture teardown. Member profile fields (marital_status, languages, civilian_degrees) were overwritten across tests; final state has them cleared (last test_clear_extras run). No orphan test data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite to inherit: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration29_profile_hours_brief.py (13 tests). Combined regression (iter25+iter27+iter28+iter29 = 73 tests, ~30s wall) is green. Notes: (1) /api/payments/zeffy/validate is GET with query param 'confirmation' (NOT POST). (2) HoursIn requires event_type ∈ {'aop_related','other'} AND host_name + host_email + host_phone (use valid email format). (3) /me/personnel-brief and /me/personnel-brief/pdf are member-side; the admin /reports/personnel-brief/{uid} still requires admin role. (4) Iter29 tests overwrite member@clubhaven.app's marital_status/languages/civilian_degrees but end with them cleared; if your test relies on those fields, set them again at fixture setup. (5) Admin Edit-hrs button visible on Approved/Pending tabs — Approved tab is the place to verify post-approval corrections.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All deliverables of iteration 29 implemented correctly: (a) profile extras (marital_status, languages, civilian_degrees) round-trip through PUT /members/me and surface via /auth/me and personnel-brief; (b) admin hours adjustment is auditable (hours_adjusted_by_name/_at) and supports re-edit after approval AND revert to pending; (c) member-side personnel-brief endpoints share the admin helper and return identical shape; PDF download works (>1 KB %PDF binary); (d) mediaUrl() correctly rewrites stale *.emergentagent.com hosts to current backend, and Home.jsx wraps every img.src — the Safari/MacBook founders issue is mitigated.
